unavailableReason: No global grid in this site for this variable: only the 7 variables with files in data/grid/ can be drawn as a distribution.
autoNothing: Follow chart / layers: no open layer or chart variable has a global grid.
error: Could not read the global distribution.
notThisMonth: Typical month, not this exact month.
method: Each calendar month is the mean of that month over {{start}}–{{end}} (monthly climatology). Dot density and brightness follow the value between the 2nd and 98th percentiles of all 12 months; no dots where there is no data.
noWind: No wind data: motion is not transport.
withTrendMap: The trend map remains underneath; distribution dots are dimmed.
particleNote: The glowing dots are a map: typical {{month}} {{variable}}.
